statement: Implement authenticated and encrypted inter-node transport (mTLS 1.3 + Ed25519 signed IDENTIFY handshake bound to URI:lagrange://<clusterId>/node/<nodeId> SAN), pluggable ClusterTrustProvider (builtin-ca, external-pki, loopback-only insecure-local-dev), CA-pinned lgr_join_v1_ single-use/TTL join tokens with CSR enrollment, symmetric lagrange cert/cluster CLI commands, and PostgreSQL SCRAM-SHA-256, SCRAM-SHA-256-PLUS (tls-server-end-point), and cert authentication.
